# Axiom Icons Library

FontAwesome icon kit for use with the Optimizely Design System.

## Getting Started

```sh
npm install @optimizely/axiom-icons
```

```tsx
import { IconMessages } from "@optimizely/icons";

function App() {
  return (
    <>
      <IconMessages />
      <IconMessages size={24} />
    </>
  );
}
```

Check out [storybook](https://main--5dcc95c567dd4d002006b897.chromatic.com/?path=/docs/informational-icon--docs) to explore all available icons.

## Contributing

Want to add a new icon to the library? Check out our [Contributing Guide](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for detailed instructions on adding FontAwesome Pro icons and custom icons.
